verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents a public GraphQL API with OAuth 2.0 service-account authentication and inline curl examples, but nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. A raw API is a developer building block, not an SDK. The axis applies to a SaaS platform like this, so the absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
